title: SkyzLibs
description: SkyzLibs is config / utility library for my Mods
body:
# SkyzLibs

A config / library For my Mods And This Mod can Optimize Your Game

## Features

• 💭**ChatUtils Option**                                                                        
• 💬**ConfigManager**                                                                                              
• 🚶‍♂️**PlayerDataManager**                                  
• 🦴**NBTUtils**      
• ⏰**CooldownManager**   
• 💨**Async Task Manager**   
• 💠**Inventory GUI Builder**   
• 👨‍💻**Custom Event System**   
• 🫧**Optimized Library** 

## Inspiration

I Inspired from my Favourite Config Libraries Mods :-

• [WalkyLibs](https://modrinth.com/project/7P86n6Vg)    
• [UkuLib](https://modrinth.com/project/Y8uFrUil)

# Thanks For Downloading My Mods ❤️
